Description: Create Organization entity, DTOs, service, controller with full CRUD operations. Organizations are top-level tenants.

- CreateOrganizationDto and UpdateOrganizationDto with validation
- OrganizationsService with create, findAll, findOne, update, delete methods
- OrganizationsController with REST endpoints
- Swagger documentation added
- Soft deletes implemented

Description: Create Workspace entity, DTOs, service, controller. Workspaces belong to organizations and provide isolation.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Workspace entity with organization relationship
- CreateWorkspaceDto and UpdateWorkspaceDto
- WorkspacesService with CRUD + organization validation
- WorkspacesController with REST endpoints
- Unique constraint on (organization_id, slug)
- Soft deletes implemented

Description: Create PostgreSQL RLS policies on all workspace-scoped tables (files, pdf_cache, reports, tags, canvases, xbrl_contexts, report_locks).
Acceptance Criteria:
- RLS enabled on 7 workspace-scoped tables
- Policies created using app.current_workspace_id
- Migration file for RLS policies
- RLS tested with different workspace_id values
- Documentation added for RLS pattern

Description: Implement middleware to set PostgreSQL session variable (app.current_workspace_id) from X-Workspace-Id header or user context.
Acceptance Criteria:
- WorkspaceMiddleware class created
- Middleware reads X-Workspace-Id header
- Sets app.current_workspace_id session variable
- Registered globally in AppModule
- Tested with database queries filtered by RLS

Description: Create User entity with password hashing, email validation. User belongs to organization.
Acceptance Criteria:
- User entity with all fields (email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, role, etc.)
- Password hashing with bcrypt (10 rounds)
- Email uniqueness constraint
- Role enum (super_admin, org_admin, workspace_admin, editor, viewer)
- Soft deletes implemented

Description: Set up JWT authentication with RSA256 signing. Access tokens (30 min) and refresh tokens (7 days).
Acceptance Criteria:
- JWT strategy implemented with Passport
- RSA256 key pair generated
- Access token expiry: 30 minutes
- Refresh token expiry: 7 days
- JwtAuthGuard created
- Tokens include userId, organizationId, role

Description: Implement POST /auth/register, POST /auth/login, POST /auth/logout, POST /auth/refresh, GET /auth/me endpoints.
Acceptance Criteria:
- POST /auth/register creates organization + admin user
- POST /auth/login validates credentials and returns tokens
- POST /auth/logout revokes refresh token
- POST /auth/refresh generates new token pair
- GET /auth/me returns current user profile
- Tokens set in httpOnly cookies

Description: Create RefreshToken entity and implement token rotation on refresh. Old tokens revoked.
Acceptance Criteria:
- RefreshToken entity created
- Token stored in database on login
- Refresh endpoint revokes old token and creates new one
- Expired tokens cleaned up (cron job)
- Revoked tokens cannot be reused

Description: Implement workspace_members CRUD: add member, list members, update role, remove member.
Acceptance Criteria:
- WorkspaceMember entity created
- Service methods: addMember, listMembers, updateRole, removeMember
- Controller endpoints: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /workspaces/:id/members
- Role-based validation (only workspace admins can manage)
- Audit logs for member changes

Description: Create invitation flow: send invite, accept invite, revoke invite. Email invitations to join workspace.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Invitation entity created
- POST /invitations endpoint (sends email)
- POST /invitations/:token/accept endpoint
- Email service integration (SendGrid or SMTP)
- Token expiry (7 days)
- Status tracking (pending, accepted, expired, revoked)

Description: Implement WorkspaceGuard to verify user has access to workspace from X-Workspace-Id header.
Acceptance Criteria:
- WorkspaceGuard checks workspace membership
- Returns 403 if user not in workspace
- Applied to all workspace-scoped endpoints
- Sets RLS session variable
- Custom decorator @WorkspaceId() to extract workspace ID

Description: Create guards and decorators for role-based permissions (admin, editor, viewer).
Acceptance Criteria:
- RolesGuard checks user role
- @Roles() decorator for controllers
- Role hierarchy: super_admin > org_admin > workspace_admin > editor > viewer
- Applied to sensitive endpoints (delete, update settings)
- Tests for permission checks

Description: Create POST /files/upload endpoint supporting PDF and DOCX files (max 70MB). Store in GCS or local filesystem.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Multer configured for multipart/form-data
- File type validation (PDF, DOCX only)
- File size limit: 70MB
- Storage adapter pattern (local vs GCS)
- File entity created with metadata
- Returns file ID and metadata

Description: Configure GCS bucket, service account, and implement storage service for production.
Acceptance Criteria:
- GCS bucket created
- Service account with storage permissions
- @google-cloud/storage library integrated
- Storage service with upload/download/delete methods
- Presigned URLs for secure downloads
- Local filesystem fallback for development

Description: Extract metadata from uploaded files: page count, dimensions, file type, MIME type.
Acceptance Criteria:
- PDF: Extract page count using pdf-parse
- DOCX: Extract page count estimate
- Store in file.metadata JSONB field
- Metadata returned in upload response
- Error handling for corrupted files

Description: Implement GET /files/:id/download that returns file stream or presigned GCS URL.
Acceptance Criteria:
- GET /files/:id/download endpoint
- For GCS: returns presigned URL (1-hour expiry)
- For local: streams file directly
- Workspace isolation enforced (RLS)
- Content-Disposition header set for download

Description: Extract full text content from PDF files using pdf-parse and pdfjs-dist. Store in pdf_cache table.
Acceptance Criteria:
- pdf-parse library integrated
- Text extracted per page
- pdfjs-dist for enhanced extraction
- Text stored in pdf_cache.text_content
- Handles multi-column layouts
- Error handling for scanned PDFs (OCR not in MVP)

Description: Extract word positions (x, y, width, height) for each word on each page. Store as JSONB in pdf_cache.word_data.
Acceptance Criteria:
- pdfjs-dist used for word extraction
- Each word: {text, x, y, width, height}
- Stored in pdf_cache.word_data as JSON array
- Tested with complex layouts
- Performance: <10s for 50-page PDF

Summary: Render PDF pages to JPEG images
Description: Render each PDF page to JPEG image at 150 DPI. Store in pdf_cache.image_data as bytea.
Acceptance Criteria:
- pdfjs-dist canvas rendering
- Resolution: 150 DPI
- Format: JPEG (quality 85)
- Stored in pdf_cache.image_data (bytea)
- GET /pdf-cache/:fileId/pages/:page/image endpoint
- Image served with proper MIME type

Summary: Create Bull queue for async processing
Description: Set up Bull queue with Redis for background PDF processing jobs. Process on upload.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Bull library integrated
- Redis connection configured
- PdfProcessingQueue created
- Job added on file upload
- Worker processes jobs asynchronously
- Job status tracking (queued, processing, completed, failed)

Description: Create Report entity, DTOs, service, controller. Report links to file and taxonomy.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Report entity with file and taxonomy relationships
- CRUD operations (create, list, get, update, delete)
- Status field (draft, review, approved, published)
- Workspace isolation enforced
- Soft deletes implemented
- Audit logging

Description: Implement Canvas entity to store editor state (blocks, tags, scroll position). POST/GET /reports/:id/canvas endpoints.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Canvas entity with one-to-one report relationship
- canvas_data JSONB field stores full state
- POST /reports/:id/canvas saves state
- GET /reports/:id/canvas retrieves state
- Auto-save on frontend (debounced)
- Version field for future conflict resolution

Description: Add filtering and sorting to GET /reports: by status, created date, taxonomy. Pagination support.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Query parameters: status, sort, page, limit
- Filter by status (draft, review, approved, published)
- Sort by createdAt, updatedAt, title
- Pagination (default 20 per page, max 100)
- Total count returned
- Performance tested with 1000+ reports

Description: Reports are automatically shared within workspace. All workspace members can view/edit based on role.
Acceptance Criteria:
- No separate sharing table (workspace-scoped by default)
- Viewer role: read-only
- Editor role: create/edit own reports
- Admin role: manage all reports
- Documented in API_ENDPOINTS.md

Description: Create Tag entity with concept_id, value, unit, decimals, context reference, text position.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Tag entity with all XBRL fields
- Relationships: report, context, created_by
- CRUD endpoints: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /tags
- Validation: concept_id format, unit codes
- start_index/end_index for text position
- page_number for multi-page PDFs

Description: GET /reports/:reportId/tags endpoint with grouping by page, concept, context.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Returns all tags for a report
- Optional grouping: by page, by concept, by context
- Includes full context details
- Includes creator information
- Sorted by creation time or page number

Description: Validate tags against taxonomy schema: concept exists, unit matches, decimals are appropriate.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Concept ID validated against taxonomy
- Unit validated against allowed units for concept
- Decimals within reasonable range (-6 to 6)
- Value matches expected data type
- Returns validation errors with details

Description: Detect overlapping tags on same text. Allow overlaps but warn user. Track by start/end index.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Check for overlapping text positions
- Allow overlaps (multiple concepts on same text)
- Return warning if overlap detected
- Prioritize by creation time (older tags first)
- Visualize overlaps in frontend

Description: Set up OpenAI API client. Create prompt templates for XBRL concept recommendation based on selected text.
Acceptance Criteria:
- OpenAI API key configured
- Prompt engineering for concept suggestion
- Input: selected text, surrounding context, taxonomy
- Output: concept suggestions with confidence scores
- Handles rate limiting (max 10 req/min per workspace)
- Error handling for API failures

Description: POST /ai/recommend-concepts endpoint. Takes selected text, returns concept suggestions with confidence.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Endpoint accepts text, reportId, taxonomyId
- Calls OpenAI with engineered prompt
- Returns array of suggestions: conceptId, label, confidence, reasoning
- Suggests value extraction and unit
- Suggests context (period)
- Response time: <5 seconds

Description: POST /ai/recommend-context endpoint. Analyzes text to suggest XBRL context (entity, period, dimensions).
Acceptance Criteria:
- Analyzes surrounding text for date references
- Suggests period type (instant vs duration)
- Extracts date ranges
- Suggests dimensions if mentioned
- Returns confidence score and reasoning

Summary: Implement XBRL context entity and CRUD
Description: Create XBRLContext entity with entity, period (instant/duration), dimensions. CRUD endpoints.
Acceptance Criteria:
- XBRLContext entity created
- Fields: contextId, entityIdentifier, entityScheme, periodType, dates, dimensions (JSONB)
- POST /reports/:reportId/contexts creates context
- GET /reports/:reportId/contexts lists all contexts
- Context reused across tags
- Validation: date ranges, entity format

Description: Validate context data: period dates are valid, instant vs duration logic, entity identifier format.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Instant: requires instant_date only
- Duration: requires start_date and end_date
- end_date must be after start_date
- Entity identifier validated (numeric or registered format)
- Dimension values validated against taxonomy

Description: Provide common context templates (annual report, quarterly, monthly) for quick creation.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Templates stored in database or config
- Common periods: FY 2023, Q4 2023, etc.
- User can create context from template
- Templates customizable per workspace
- API: GET /contexts/templates

Description: When creating tag, suggest 3 most recently used contexts for the report.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Query last 10 tags in report
- Group by context_id
- Return top 3 by frequency
- Include in tag creation response
- Speeds up tagging workflow

Description: POST /taxonomies endpoint (super_admin only). Upload ZIP file with taxonomy XSD schemas.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Multer for ZIP upload
- Extract ZIP to storage (GCS or local)
- Parse taxonomy metadata (name, version, namespace)
- Store in taxonomies table
- Validate ZIP contains required files (.xsd)
- Admin-only endpoint

Description: Extract namespace, schemaRefs, concept list from uploaded taxonomy XSD files.
Acceptance Criteria:
- XML parser for .xsd files
- Extract namespace URI
- Extract schema location
- List all concepts (elements)
- Store in taxonomy.metadata JSONB
- Handle multiple linked schemas

Description: POST /workspaces/:id/taxonomies/:taxonomyId/assign endpoint. Assign taxonomy to workspace. Set default.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Creates workspace_taxonomies record
- Validates taxonomy is active
- One default taxonomy per workspace
- Admin-only operation
- Unassign endpoint: DELETE /workspaces/:id/taxonomies/:taxonomyId

Description: GET /taxonomies/:id/concepts endpoint. Browse taxonomy structure with search and filtering.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Returns concept tree or flat list
- Search by concept ID or label
- Filter by category/module (e.g., ESRS E1)
- Paginated response
- Cached in Redis (5 min TTL)

Description: Create service to generate iXBRL XML from report tags and contexts. Multi-taxonomy support (ESRS, GRI, SASB).
Acceptance Criteria:
- Generates inline XBRL HTML+XML
- Namespace declarations for each taxonomy
- schemaRef links to taxonomy XSD
- Context definitions in header
- Unit definitions (EUR, tCO2e, etc.)
- ix:nonFraction and ix:nonNumeric elements
- Handles tag placement in document text

Description: POST /reports/:id/export/ixbrl endpoint. Returns iXBRL XML file for download.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Validates report has tags and contexts
- Calls iXBRL generation service
- Returns XML with proper Content-Type
- Content-Disposition: attachment
- Filename: report-title-ixbrl.xml
- Logs export in audit_logs

Description: POST /reports/:id/validate endpoint. Validate report against taxonomy: missing contexts, invalid concepts, etc.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Check all tags reference valid contexts
- Check all concept IDs exist in taxonomy
- Check units match concept requirements
- Check decimals are appropriate
- Return errors and warnings
- Does not block export (warnings only)

Description: POST /reports/:id/lock endpoint. Acquire edit lock. Returns 409 if already locked by another user.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Creates record in report_locks table
- Sets expires_at to 15 minutes from now
- Returns lock details (locked_by, expires_at)
- If already locked by same user: refresh lock
- If locked by other: return 409 with lock details
- Stores client info (IP, user agent)

Description: PUT /reports/:id/lock/refresh endpoint. Extends lock expiry by 15 minutes. Called every 60 seconds from frontend.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Updates last_activity_at and expires_at
- Returns new expiry time
- Only lock owner can refresh
- Returns 404 if lock doesn't exist
- Returns 403 if different user

Description: DELETE /reports/:id/lock endpoint. Releases lock. Called on save or editor unmount.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Deletes lock from report_locks table
- Only lock owner can release
- Returns 204 No Content
- Idempotent (no error if lock doesn't exist)
- Audit log entry

Description: GET /reports/:id/lock endpoint. Check if report is locked and by whom. Used for read-only mode.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Returns isLocked boolean
- If locked: returns locked_by user details and expires_at
- If not locked: returns null
- Used by frontend to show lock banner
- No authentication required (public within workspace)

Description: DELETE /reports/:id/lock/force endpoint (admin only). Forcefully remove lock from any user.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Admin or super_admin only
- Deletes lock regardless of owner
- Sends notification to lock owner (optional)
- Audit log entry with admin user
- Used for stuck locks

Description: Cron job runs every 5 minutes. Deletes locks where expires_at < NOW().
Acceptance Criteria:
- @Cron decorator with '*/5 * * * *' pattern
- Queries locks with expires_at in past
- Deletes expired locks
- Logs count of cleaned locks
- Tested with manual expiry times
